issues.description: The solution's Lecture constructor declares the parameter for numberOfLecturers as byte, while the problem statement's UML and descriptions treat numberOfLecturers as an int. This creates a structural inconsistency: students reading the specification expect an int parameter but the solution uses byte. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended type and lead to API differences when comparing their implementation to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter type consistent with the UML/problem statement by changing the constructor signature in the solution to use int for numberOfLecturers (and update the backing field to int if necessary). Alternatively, if byte was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to specify byte so all artifacts agree.
